# Our Mumu Don Do

> Big Adventures. True History. Sharp Minds. An interactive educational digital storybook for children aged 7 to 10 celebrating authentic African history, critical thinking, and indigenous innovation.

Our Mumu Don Do (a beloved Nigerian Pidgin English phrase meaning "Our foolishness is enough!") is an educational storytelling platform designed to empower the next generation. We bring ancient African history, courageous rulers, clever tricksters, and rich cultures to life through illustrated, interactive audio tales that foster independent thinking, curiosity, and pride in African heritage.

## Core Navigation
- [Home / Kids Edition Discovery](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/): Gamified adventure catalog featuring story archetypes (Kings & Warriors, Riddles & Mysteries, Ancient Wonders), quest streak tracking, and daily mystery riddles.
- [About Page](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/about): Mission statement, pedagogical pillars, technological stack, copyright & fair use notice, Mama Africa tribute, and Pidgin English learning link.

## Curated Educational Stories
The platform features authentic, curated historical stories designed specifically for young explorers:

- [The Great Giants of Zazzau](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/story/the-great-giants-of-zazzau): Queen Amina, Warrior of Zazzau (Northern Kingdom). Explores tactical leadership, ancient earthen fortress walls, and the protection of savannah trade routes. Includes an interactive illustrated storybook viewer.
- [Arhuan: The Giant Prince of Benin](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/story/arhuan-the-giant-prince-of-benin): Inspired by Mama Africa, celebrating the ancient Benin Kingdom, bronze metallurgy, and defending waterways. Features an interactive illustrated storybook viewer.
- [The King's Signature](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/story/the-kings-signature): King Duke Ephraim and the 1855 Calabar law protecting twin children 21 years before foreign missionaries arrived, highlighting local agency in humanitarian reform.
- [The Glass of Milk](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/story/the-glass-of-milk): A critical thinking parable teaching kids about corruption versus integrity using clear, everyday metaphors.
- [The River Was Always There](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/story/the-river-was-always-there): Debunks colonial discovery narratives by showing the vibrant indigenous civilizations that navigated and lived alongside the River Niger for centuries.
- [Understanding Colonisation](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/story/understanding-colonisation): An age-appropriate historical breakdown of African sovereignty, resource management, and resilience.
- [We Were Never Lost](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/story/we-were-never-lost): King Jaja of Opobo and the commercial independence of the Niger Delta river trade.
- [The River of a Thousand Songs](https://our-mumu-don-do.sabiai.work/story/the-river-of-a-thousand-songs): A lyrical journey celebrating the preservation of ancestral songs, indigenous instruments, and oral storytelling traditions.

## Educational Pillars
1. **True History & Real Heroes**: True accounts of African monarchs, warrior queens, and community builders.
2. **Smart Inventions & Local Solutions**: Indigenous architecture, metallurgy, river navigation, and local problem-solving.
3. **Question Everything (Sharp Thinking)**: Active questioning, brain teasers, and detective-style critical reasoning.
4. **One People, Many Wonders**: Unity across diverse Nigerian languages, traditions, and customs.

## Multilingual & Audio Features
- **High-Quality Audio Narrations**: Built-in audio playback for all 8 stories.
- **Swiss German & Pidgin English Narrations**: Multi-dialect narration capabilities (English, Nigerian Pidgin, Swiss German `de-CH`) for global and diaspora youth.
- **WhatsApp & Social Audiograms**: Pre-rendered 15-second vertical (9:16) MP4 video audiograms with animated soundwave visualizers, book cover art, story titles, and links for one-tap WhatsApp Status sharing.
- **Interactive Storybook Viewer**: Page-turning reader and downloadable PDF editions for selected books.

## Companion Resources
- [Naija Speak](https://naijaspeak.sabiai.work/): A digital dictionary and learning companion for Nigerian Pidgin English vocabulary, grammar, and expressions.
- [Mama Africa Folklore Video](https://youtu.be/I_xZDq9vj7c?si=jykeZn-g5xbh8qbw): Traditional oral storytelling performance honoring the legacy of ancestral folklore.

## Creative Process & Child Safety
- **Human Authorship**: Storylines conceived, researched, and written by Stefan Asemota.
- **AI Collaboration**: Illustrations and narrations created with AI tools under strict human creative direction.
- **Human Verification**: 100% reviewed and verified by Stefan for cultural authenticity.
- **Age Appropriateness**: Certified family-safe for children ages 7 and up.

## Technical Details
- **Architecture**: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ShadCN UI.
- **AI Integration**: Firebase Genkit and Google Gemini for creative storytelling adaptation.
- **Crawler Policy**: Open and friendly to AI indexing agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, etc.) with robots.txt and sitemap.xml.
